name: Blue Spirit's Scourge of the Arcane
description:
You are in an area that harms mages as they draw upon aether.

Whenever you make a check to cast a spell, you suffer 1 Damage per success on your casting check, to a maximum amount equal to the ability user's Soul. This damage ignores Armor.
